title: Manyhands JSON v1 ticket relationship check
description: What a proposed deps and parent come to for one ticket, and whether a save that wrote them would be rejected. The check is a read that succeeded either way: a rejection that is not null is its answer, not its failure.

deps.description: The proposed dependencies as a save writes them: in ID order, each once.

unresolved.description: The proposed dependencies and parent that nothing the index holds has the ID of, in ID order, each once. They are accepted.

rejection.description: Null when a save may write these relationships. Otherwise the result code a save would be rejected with and the IDs it is about, in ID order: for relationship_cycle the tickets of the cycle, the ticket itself included, and for invalid_relationship the proposed IDs that are a document's or a comment's.

complete.description: False when the last refresh could not read, or stopped part of the way through, .manyhands/tickets, .manyhands or .manyhands/worktrees. Tickets may then be missing from what the check was made against while index.state is current.

index.description: The state of the index the check answered from. The check scans nothing, so an answer from an index that is not current may lack tickets a refresh would bring.
